method: tests/e2e/layout-audit.ts measures the DOM that is drawn: no sideways scroll of the page or of any container (R18), no word over another word or under a control that does not contain it, no word outside its card or button, no tap target under 44 px (40 px in dense repeated groups, R04), words an ellipsis clips listed, words broken mid-word listed; a scrolling page is audited at every paging position and at its end with floating buttons checked. The audit proves itself on a synthetic page (an overlap, a word under a control, a small control, a clipped container, a sideways scroll) and on a clean one. Review PNGs (screen and image for every size and page) were written to a scratch directory outside the repository and not committed.

findings.spec: tests/e2e/ug2-hostile-roster.spec.ts: keeps the crew page inside the screen at 320 px with 200% text
findings.measured: The composition region scrolls sideways by 42 px (content 338 against 296) because crew cards and header rows are wider than the screen; the same happens with the plain 13-crew course of F3, so it is not special to hostile names. M, SM, C and role badges of a person run under the 44 px remove button; the A terra rows draw words outside their buttons; the bottom bar breaks its own labels mid-word. The ug1 and c1 specs look only at the document's width, which the region's own scroll hides.
findings.decision: Fixed: container queries in rem drop a column or wrap only when enlarged text needs it; 56 reference screenshots at 412, 390 and 360 px with ordinary text are pixel-identical before and after. The test now passes on its projects.

findings.spec: tests/e2e/ug2-hostile-roster.spec.ts: keeps at least the first three letters of every name legible on the crew cards...
findings.measured: Names clipped by the card's ellipsis show under three letters' width for 1 of 16 clipped names at 390 px, 10 of 25 at 360 px, 17 of 30 at 320 px (a minor with a smontante or comandata badge keeps 3 px of the name), and all 34 at 320 px with 200% text (a volunteer's name has no width). The full name stays in the accessible name and a long press opens the student; tests/e2e/c1-crew-management.spec.ts pins the ellipsis.
findings.decision: Left as a fixme for the owner: real course names are mostly short first names; recorded as a known limitation in CHANGELOG.md 0.3.0.
